newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike Inc Q2 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike Inc Q2 estimate cut.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities analyst Alice Ruth said in a research report she was trimming second quarter earnings estimates to $0.53-$0.54 per share from $0.56 after learning that the company's marketing expenses will be higher than previously planned.

-- She maintained her buy recommendation on the stock and her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate of $2.60 per share, saying she still needed to investigate whether the higher expenses would affect subsequent quarters.

--"I think investors are leery of the next two months leading up to Christmas because September retail sales were not that great. But Nike is one of the better performers in the (retail and apparel) group," Esquivel added.
